assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable ground material texture for a top-down 2D dark fantasy shinobi dungeon sector, consumed as an SVG pattern beneath actual game map geometry. Create ONE square texture of an ancient subterranean fortress floor. Perfectly straight overhead orthographic view, no horizon, no perspective. Weathered large irregular slate paving blocks with worn beveled edges, hairline cracks, ash, thin moss tucked into cracks, subtle damp patches, delicate eroded shinobi seal carvings barely visible. Cool slate gray and muted blue green stone with warm faint mineral stains, medium dark values but highly readable details. Beautiful hand-painted semi-realistic fantasy game background art, painterly micro texture, tactile natural stone, restrained contrast, flat diffuse ambient lighting. Texture fills entire image edge to edge, seamless repeat at all four edges, consistent scale with no obvious central focal point. No walls, objects, statues, torches, characters, text, borders, UI, logos, or grid overlay. Do not draw a dungeon map or room; this is only the walkable stone ground material.

Rich hand-painted semi-realistic fantasy game background, detailed tactile stone, natural painterly variation, diffuse ambient illumination with subtle eerie glow, no sharp directional shadows.
